newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Alpargatas to issue $40 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Alpargatas to issue $40 mln bond.

text.p: Argentina's footwear and textile company Alpargatas SAIC said Friday it will issue $40 million worth of negotiable bonds on February 18.
The bonds will mature in August 1998 and will yield no more than 12 percent at issuance, Alpargatas said in a statement.
Alpargatas will guarantee the issue and the funds will be used to refinance liabilities.
The underwriter will be Andino Capital Markets.
The bond is part of Alpargatas' $150 million negotiable bond program. It has not yet been decided where the bond will be listed.
